1. Get-ChildItem
2. Get-Content README.md
3. Get-Location
4. Test-Path README.md
5. Select-String -Path README.md -Pattern word
6. git status
7. New-Item -ItemType File made.txt
Then answer with one line per command: its number and whether it ran or was refused.
